Implementation complete. `analysis.py` runs end-to-end in ~160 s and produces all four required artifacts plus three diagnostic files. Results, evidence, and the verifications you requested follow.

`metric_gap = primary − secondary` is asserted in code and holds exactly. Pattern is physically coherent: the two linearized low-salt ligand cases (000/001) show the largest primary/secondary discrepancy; the nonlinear higher-salt cases (002–007) agree much better, and the two eps_in=12 cases (006/007) give smaller responses than their eps_in=2 twins (004/005) as expected.

## (a) Convergence diagnostics (results/solve_diagnostics.csv, 48 rows: 3 entities × medium+vacuum × 8 cases)

- 24 linearized/direct solves (cases 000–001 medium; all 48 vacuum solves): `direct-linear`, exact-solver residuals 1e-16…7e-15 (relative inf-norm).
- All 18 nonlinear Newton medium solves (cases 002–007): status **newton-converged**, 1–2 iterations each, final relative residuals 1e-16…4.7e-10 (tolerance 1e-9). Example: case_004 assembly, 2 iterations, rel residual 7.2e-16, max|φ| = 15.72 kcal/mol/e; case_006 assembly 1 iteration, 4.0e-10, max|φ| = 11.83. The sinh argument is clipped at |arg| ≤ 700 (`SINH_ARG_CLIP` labeled constant), steps are trust-capped at 10 and backtracked (line search to 1/64) — no divergence occurred anywhere.
- max|φ| ranges: medium 3.55–15.72; vacuum 30.2–447.8 kcal/mol/e (the 447.8 is the single +2 ion in vacuum, Coulomb-like — sane).

## (b) Vacuum operator = same code path, uniform-eps special case

`verify_vacuum_special_case` builds the vacuum operator through the identical `build_operator` call (uniform `eps_in`, f=0, κ=0) and checks against the analytic uniform-grid expectation: diagonal = 6·h·ε_in exactly, 6 interior off-diagonals each −h·ε_in at a central node, matrix symmetric, screening row exactly zero, and row sums equal exactly h·ε_in × (number of Dirichlet boundary faces of that node) — i.e., interior fluxes cancel and boundary fluxes fold into the diagonal. All five checks pass for all 8 cases (results/vacuum_operator_check.csv, all True). The builder was additionally validated against an independent brute-force dense assembly on a shrunk grid (max |Δ| = 0.0).

## (c) Single-ion cross term (cases 004–007)

part_b is one ion (q=+2, r=1.39 Å) at 1.07 Å from its nearest part_a site; 84 part_a sites lie within 6.5 Å. The cross term is strongly nonzero: secondary = 188.2/187.7/27.8/27.8 kcal/mol for cases 004/005/006/007 (per_case_detail.csv). Cases 000–003 have 378/382 cross pairs respectively.

## (d) Determinism and output integrity

- `field_samples.npy`: shape (8, 24), dtype float32, all finite, range −288.06…+59.97 kcal/mol/e (assembly reaction field trilinearly interpolated at the 24 query points; largest magnitudes occur 0.2 Å from the +2 ion in cases 004/005).
- `field_slice.npy`: shape (8, 35, 35), dtype float32, all finite, range −81.5…+123.4; each slice is the nodal plane from plane_spec laid out literally per `storage_order` (z-planes: field[:,:,pi]; y-planes: field[:,pi,:] — verified identical to the storage_order permutation).
- Shapes/dtypes asserted in code before writing; CSV written full-precision; `gap = primary − secondary` asserted.
- Determinism proven: a complete second run reproduced byte-identical md5 checksums for all three deliverable data files and overview.png.

## Environment deviation (disclosed)

matplotlib is listed in the runtime policy but is not installed in this machine's Python environment (no PIL/ImageMagick/ffmpeg either, no network). `analysis.py` prefers matplotlib when importable (the full 8×3-panel matplotlib figure) and otherwise falls back to a self-contained pure-numpy PNG renderer (zlib/struct PNG writer + 5×7 bitmap font) producing the same 8×3 overview: per-case SES-SDF slice on the prescribed plane, reaction-field slice, and primary-vs-secondary bars. The delivered `results/overview.png` (1056×2850 px, valid PNG, 45% non-white content) came from the fallback renderer.

## Method notes / limitations

- Assembly geometry is the supplied `volume_a` SES tensor (authoritative); part_a/part_b SES/SAS are reconstructed from their own sites.csv rows per the contract (nearest-atom VDW mask, radius+probe SAS, probe dilation→erosion→union VDW, EDT signed distances). At this grid resolution (h ≈ 1.8–2.2 Å > probe ≤ 1.4 Å) the grid-EDT dilation/erosion degenerates so the component SES equals the VDW mask; this literal reading also best matches the supplied reference tensors (0.5–0.8% voxel mismatch including a common ~0.5% voxelization baseline; SAS matches volume_b to 0.3–0.4% on every case). This is the residual reconstruction uncertainty — it only affects component shell dielectrics and Born radii, not the assembly field outputs.
- Nonlinear regime implemented as the same operator with κ²·f·sinh(φ) in native kcal/mol/e units (your confirmed adjudication, labeled/flippable in code); smol solvent fraction = 0.5(1+tanh(SDF/0.3)); Born radius = max(atom radius, |component SES SDF| trilinear at site).
- Extra diagnostic files (solve_diagnostics.csv, vacuum_operator_check.csv, per_case_detail.csv) are supplementary; the five required artifacts are all present at their exact native paths.
